labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

data_width.title: Data size
data_width.description: Choose the size of a single data (multiples of 8 are recommended).

extend_data_width.title: Non standard data sizes
extend_data_width.description: Add the possibility to choose more data size.

clock_source.title: Clock source
clock_source.description: Clock source can be modified in clock tree.

clock_source_frequency.title: Clock source frequency
clock_source_frequency.description: Input clock frequency can be modified in clock tree.

baud_rate_prescaler.title: Clock prescaler
baud_rate_prescaler.description: This prescaler divides the clock source frequency to get the final baud rate of SPI bus.

baud_rate.title: Baud rate
baud_rate.description: Frequency of SPI peripheral clock source need to be lower than SPI APB bus frequency.

clock_polarity.title: Clock polarity
clock_polarity.description: Choose level of clock signal when clock is in IDLE state.

clock_phase.title: Clock phase
clock_phase.description: Choose if data is captured on first or second edge of the clock signal.

actions.message: Only MSB first is allowed in TI mode.

nss_pin_management.title: NSS signal type (chip select)
nss_pin_management.description: Choose if NSS signal is managed by software (Deactivated) or hardware (Activated).

actions.message: NSS pin management is mandatory in TI mode.

set_fifo_threshold.title: FIFO threshold

actions.message: Packet size exceed maximal FIFO size.

set_fifo_threshold.description: Choose a multiple of data size to define a FIFO threshold.

actions.message: The selected interconnect must be configured manually

crc_polynomial.title: CRC polynomial
crc_polynomial.description: Set CRC generating polynomial as a 7, 8, 16 or 32-bit long value for a polynomial degree respectively equal to 7, 8, 16 or 32.

crc_tx_init_pattern.description: Init value to initiate Tx CRC computation.
crc_tx_init_pattern.title: Tx CRC init pattern

crc_rx_init_pattern.description: Init value to initiate Rx CRC computation.
crc_rx_init_pattern.title: Rx CRC init pattern

nss_pulse.description: Enable NSS pulse between two consecutive data frame transfers.
nss_pulse.title: NSS pulse mode

actions.message: NSS pulse mode is not allowed when data is captured on second edge of the clock signal.
NSS signal polarity is not configurable in TI mode or when NSS pulse mode is enabled.

nss_mssi_delay.title: Master SS idleness

actions.message: Master SS idleness is not configurable in TI mode.

nss_mssi_delay.description: Time between the activation of chip select (NSS) and the first transferred data.

underrun_configuration.title: Underrun
underrun_configuration.description: Slave can send a constant pattern to the master or repeat the last pattern received from the master.

set_midi_idleness_delay.title: Master Inter Data Idleness

actions.message: Master inter data idleness is only configurable in master mode with Motorola protocol.

set_midi_idleness_delay.description: Minimum time delay inserted between two consecutive data frames (available in master mode only with Motorola protocol).

actions.message: Ready pin is not available in TI mode.

ready_pin_polarity.title: Ready signal polarity

oneOf.title: High
oneOf.description: High level of the signal means the slave is ready for communication.

oneOf.title: Low
oneOf.description: Low level of the signal means the slave is ready for communication.

ready_pin_polarity.description: Choose the signal level for which the slave is ready to communicate.

enable_mosi_miso_swap.title: IO swap
enable_mosi_miso_swap.description: Invert MOSI and MISO alternate functions.

lock_io_config.title: Lock IO
lock_io_config.description: Lock the alternate function configuration of associated I/Os.

security_privilege.title: Security and privilege
security_privilege.description: Manage security and privileged access levels attributes.

security.title: Security attribute
security.description: Set the security attribute of the securable peripheral.

actions.message: The security attribute of the peripheral is automatically set to secure when the peripheral is bound to a secure resource and to non-secure when it is not. Manual configuration is not allowed.

privilege.title: Privileged attribute
privilege.description: Manage the privileged attribute of a securable RISC peripheral.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Optional. Lock security and privilege attributes to prevent changes.

actions.message: Secure-only mode: Illegal access interrupt is forced to disabled.
Interrupt is mandatory when DMA is enabled.
